dedupe_keys.name: eurocodes european structural and geotechnical design standards jrc eurocodes portal

description: The Eurocodes are the European standards giving a common approach to structural and geotechnical design of buildings and infrastructure, and the JRC's Eurocodes portal presents the family from EN 1990 to EN 1999 plus EN 19100 and two technical specifications, with news, events, JRC reports and learning material. Second-generation Eurocode parts were to be distributed by CEN to national standards bodies by 30 March 2026; the portal carries slide decks on changes in each Eurocode, reports such as design examples of the key changes and rules for reusing reclaimed steel, and in August 2026 announced JRC webinars for October and November 2026. It also reports international uptake, such as a May 2026 licence agreement for Cambodia to adopt more than 50 Eurocode parts. Coverage: European standards, also licensed for adoption outside Europe. Access: free portal; standards are bought from national bodies. Licence: portal content free. Caveats: the portal gives background and guidance, while the standard texts themselves must be bought. Simulation uses are design loads and resistance rules for structural archetypes in fragility and resilience studies. Related records: ICC Digital Codes.
